scope: Structural exposition revision following the whole-paper human-reader review. The four findings were strategy before machinery, an explicit seed-to-nonvanishing connection, the determinant purpose before the calculation, and an expanded infinite-tail estimate.
changes: The introduction begins its proof discussion with the assumption of at most two irrational values. It explains why fixed weights and three forms are useful before displaying the forms, and defers exact denominator and decay constants to the proof.
The introduction and dilation opening explain why a nonzero constant alone is insufficient, and how scaling and reduction modulo a large prime separate it from the remaining rational beta terms.
Section 6 begins with w=v_i cross v_j and q_w(2)=det(q(2),v_i,v_j). It presents the modular determinant test before deriving the three seed residues.
The seed lemma now states only the nonvanishing certificate. The unchanged exact decay code is placed with the analytic estimates in Section 4.
The infinite-tail estimate displays the grid integral bound, rewrites C_n to expose n^(293n), and explains its cancellation against the tail power.
The three-form preview and its interpretation are kept together. The modulo-5 product example is kept with its notation and conclusion.
